notes.title: Overload is available on Early Access
notes.content:
[b]Overload[/b] is now available through [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/448850] Steam Early Access![/url]
If you like the gameplay in the Playable Teaser, Early Access gives you more content with new additions every month, the latest improvements, regular updates, and the full game at final release later in 2017.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12549839/8fd22d4ae87bbd257083b39dd3f7f223c67c596d.png[/img]

[h1]Features In Early Access:[/h1]
- Full-sized singleplayer campaign level
- Level features including cryo-chamber, energy centers and lockdown event
- 5 Challenge Mode levels
- 6 new robots
- Local and online leaderboards
- New weapon: Nova
- Smash attack


[h1]Improvements and Fixes:[/h1]
- VR recentering fixed
- Performance optimizations
- HUD changes
- More control options
- Brightness option

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12549839/59f87455bda69c45e2c68a10e13b04b95cd90a6c.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12549839/7c5239b90123a1754a8c0c547367f7bb780f1ce6.png[/img]
